mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.summary, p.eligibility, p.deadline_text, p.method_text, p.notice, p.situation, p.phase_code, p.published, p.revision, p.region_id, p.category_id, r.name AS region_name, c.name AS category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_PROCEDURE_I18N WHERE procedure_id = p.id AND language_code = 'ko') AS has_ko, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_PROCEDURE_I18N WHERE procedure_id = p.id AND language_code = 'en') AS has_en FROM JL_PROCEDURE p JOIN JL_REGION r ON r.id = p.region_id JOIN JL_CATEGORY c ON c.id = p.category_id ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.summary, p.eligibility, p.deadline_text, p.method_text, p.notice, p.situation, p.phase_code, p.published, p.revision, r.name AS region_name, c.name AS category_name FROM JL_PROCEDURE p JOIN JL_REGION r ON r.id = p.region_id JOIN JL_CATEGORY c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_PROCEDURE_I18N WHERE procedure_id = #{procedureId} AND language_code = #{lang}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JL_PROCEDURE_I18N (procedure_id, language_code, title, summary, eligibility, deadline_text, method_text, notice) VALUES (#{procedureId}, #{lang}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{eligibility}, #{deadline}, #{method}, #{notice})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_PROCEDURE WHERE published = 'Y'

SELECT d.id, d.procedure_id, d.name, d.requirement, d.condition_text, d.display_order, p.title AS procedure_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_DOCUMENT_I18N WHERE document_id = d.id AND language_code = 'ko') AS has_ko, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_DOCUMENT_I18N WHERE document_id = d.id AND language_code = 'en') AS has_en FROM JL_DOCUMENT d JOIN JL_PROCEDURE p ON p.id = d.procedure_id ORDER BY d.procedure_id, d.display_order
SELECT d.id, d.procedure_id, d.name, d.requirement, d.condition_text, d.display_order, p.title AS procedure_title FROM JL_DOCUMENT d JOIN JL_PROCEDURE p ON p.id = d.procedure_id WHERE d.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_DOCUMENT_I18N WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND language_code = #{lang}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JL_DOCUMENT_I18N (document_id, language_code, name, condition_text) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{lang}, #{name}, #{conditionText})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.procedure_id, s.step_no, s.title, s.description, p.title AS procedure_title FROM JL_STEP s JOIN JL_PROCEDURE p ON p.id = s.procedure_id ORDER BY s.procedure_id, s.step_no

SELECT s.id, s.procedure_id, s.title, s.url, TO_CHAR(s.checked_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS checked_on, TO_CHAR(s.updated_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updated_on, p.title AS procedure_title FROM JL_SOURCE s JOIN JL_PROCEDURE p ON p.id = s.procedure_id ORDER BY s.procedure_id, s.id
SELECT id, name, address, homepage_url, note FROM JL_OFFICE ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JL_PROCEDURE (id, region_id, category_id, title, summary, eligibility, deadline_text, method_text, notice, situation, phase_code, published, revision, updated_at) VALUES (jl_procedure_seq.NEXTVAL, #{regionId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{eligibility}, #{deadline}, #{method}, #{notice}, #{situation}, #{phase}, #{published}, #{revision}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE JL_PROCEDURE SET region_id = #{regionId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, eligibility = #{eligibility}, deadline_text = #{deadline}, method_text = #{method}, notice = #{notice}, situation = #{situation}, phase_code = #{phase}, published = #{published}, revision = #{revision}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE JL_PROCEDURE SET published = CASE published WHEN 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JL_DOCUMENT (id, procedure_id, name, requirement, condition_text, display_order) VALUES (jl_document_seq.NEXTVAL, #{procedureId}, #{name}, #{requirement}, #{conditionText}, #{displayOrder})
INSERT INTO JL_STEP (id, procedure_id, step_no, title, description) VALUES (jl_step_seq.NEXTVAL, #{procedureId}, #{stepNo}, #{title}, #{description})
INSERT INTO JL_SOURCE (id, procedure_id, title, url, checked_on, updated_on) VALUES (jl_source_seq.NEXTVAL, #{procedureId}, #{title}, #{url}, #{checkedOn}, #{updatedOn})
INSERT INTO JL_OFFICE (id, name, address, homepage_url, note) VALUES (jl_office_seq.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{address}, #{homepageUrl}, #{note})
